knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.

doesNotKnow: Tile a narrow board using a frontier occupancy mask that remembers protruding dominoes.

misconception: Each column can be tiled independently of neighbouring columns.
objective: Tile a narrow board using a frontier occupancy mask that remembers protruding dominoes.

claims.text: The frontier mask remembers horizontal dominoes protruding into the next column. Only an empty final frontier counts as a complete tiling; blocked cells reject conflicting incoming pieces.
